editorial:
Ever wonder what goes on in the world of tooth fairies? You get to find out through Van, a brave kid who is the son of the big boss in fairy land. He is just starting his first big mission when he bumps into Gemma, a girl from the goblin tribe. Now, you are told that fairies and goblins have hated each other for ages, but Van and Gemma quickly realize they are actually a lot alike. The whole movie has a bright, magical feel that makes you feel like you are stepping into a colorful storybook, and the friendship between the two leads is really sweet to watch.

What really makes this movie pop is the action during the fight against the Spider Queen. The pacing is quick, and the animation looks crisp and polished. While a few of the jokes feel a bit cheesy, the heart of the story is definitely there. You should definitely check this out if you have kids or just want something light. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the colors, or grab the 4K Blu-ray if you like keeping physical movies in your collection.
endingExplained: In the final battle, Van and Gemma combine their fairy magic and goblin strength to trap the Spider Queen in her own web. The big twist is that the Spider Queen was actually stealing teeth to build a giant throne of power. Once she is defeated, the fairies and goblins decide to stop fighting and sign a peace treaty. Everyone celebrates together, and Van is hailed as a hero for bringing the two tribes together for good.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves magical adventures and stories about unlikely friendships.
